text.card: A red giant 3,697 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.03 solar masses and 15.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,465 K at its surface.
